name: Fix a Slow Computer
description: Diagnose and fix a slow, laggy, or unresponsive computer by checking actual RAM usage, CPU load, running applications, and disk space
prompt: Run get_system_info and list_running_apps. ONLY report what the tools actually return — do not guess or add information. State the #1 cause from the data, then give 1-3 fix steps. If the tool data doesn't match the user's reported device, note that and give general advice instead.
